basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old student from Oregon, trying to navigate the world of hormone replacement therapy. My interests include DIY projects, particularly those that help with personal transitions, and I'm quite passionate about inclusive communities. I dislike misinformation and judgmental attitudes. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after classes. Currently single, focusing on personal growth and studies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of hormone replacement therapy mostly through online research and community forums. My knowledge is largely self-taught, supplemented by advice from online communities and occasional consultations with healthcare professionals.
